    package com.rustypayments;

    import java.time.*;
    import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
    import java.util.Set;

    public class ModernPaymentCalendar implements PaymentCalendar {
        private static final ZoneId BANK_ZONE = ZoneId.of("Europe/Warsaw");
        private static final Set<MonthDay> HOLIDAYS = Set.of(
            MonthDay.of(Month.JANUARY, 1),
            MonthDay.of(Month.JANUARY, 6),
            MonthDay.of(Month.MAY, 1),
            MonthDay.of(Month.MAY, 3),
            MonthDay.of(Month.AUGUST, 15),
            MonthDay.of(Month.NOVEMBER, 1),
            MonthDay.of(Month.NOVEMBER, 11),
            MonthDay.of(Month.DECEMBER, 25),
            MonthDay.of(Month.DECEMBER, 26)
        );

        @Override
        public boolean isBusinessDay(String date) {
            LocalDate d = parseLocalDate(date);
            return isBusinessDay(d);
        }

        private boolean isBusinessDay(LocalDate date) {
            DayOfWeek dow = date.getDayOfWeek();
            if (dow == DayOfWeek.SATURDAY || dow == DayOfWeek.SUNDAY) {
                return false;
            }
            if (HOLIDAYS.contains(MonthDay.from(date))) {
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public String processingDate(String submittedAt) {
            ZonedDateTime zdt = parseZonedDateTime(submittedAt).withZoneSameInstant(BANK_ZONE);
            LocalDate processing = getProcessingLocalDate(zdt);
            return processing.toString();
        }

        private LocalDate getProcessingLocalDate(ZonedDateTime zdt) {
            LocalDate localDate = zdt.toLocalDate();
            LocalTime time = zdt.toLocalTime();
            if (isBusinessDay(localDate) && !time.isAfter(LocalTime.of(16, 0, 0))) {
                return localDate;
            } else {
                return nextBusinessDay(localDate);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public String settlementDate(String submittedAt) {
            ZonedDateTime zdt = parseZonedDateTime(submittedAt).withZoneSameInstant(BANK_ZONE);
            LocalDate processing = getProcessingLocalDate(zdt);
            return nextBusinessDay(processing).toString();
        }

        private LocalDate nextBusinessDay(LocalDate from) {
            LocalDate d = from;
            do {
                d = d.plusDays(1);
            } while (!isBusinessDay(d));
            return d;
        }

        @Override
        public int daysLate(String dueDate, String paidAt) {
            LocalDate due = parseLocalDate(dueDate);
            ZonedDateTime zdt = parseZonedDateTime(paidAt).withZoneSameInstant(BANK_ZONE);
            LocalDate paidDate = zdt.toLocalDate();
            long diff = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(due, paidDate);
            return (int) Math.max(0, diff);
        }

        @Override
        public String addMonths(String date, int months) {
            LocalDate start = parseLocalDate(date);
            boolean isMonthEnd = start.getDayOfMonth() == start.lengthOfMonth();
            LocalDate result = start.plusMonths(months);
            if (isMonthEnd) {
                result = result.withDayOfMonth(result.lengthOfMonth());
            }
            return result.toString();
        }

        private LocalDate parseLocalDate(String date) {
            if (date == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null date");
            try {
                return LocalDate.parse(date);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid date: " + date, e);
            }
        }

        private ZonedDateTime parseZonedDateTime(String instant) {
            if (instant == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null instant");
            try {
                return ZonedDateTime.parse(instant);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid instant: " + instant, e);
            }
        }
    }
